title: Giant Attribute Tweak
description: Changes the Giant Mob attribute to make it compatible with mods that adds IA
body: This datapack simply changes the "step_height" and "safe_fall_distance" attribute from giants to make them scarier. It doesn't add IA tho It's meant to be used along with others mods, such as [Giant spawn mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/giant-spawn)
